text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
When I read in our room, she leans against 
my back, or hugs me claiming it's a 
"massage"— I wonder if Vivlos is actually 
feeling lonely?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Still, she's always surrounded by friends, 
full of lively energy. Her family seems 
close-knit too... Sigh, never mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"If that's the case, does that mean 
Vivlos's actions aren't her trying to act 
spoiled?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah! Come to think of it, she always 
hugs me saying, 'Recharging my 
Mecchan-senpai energy~☆'!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Is something being sucked out of me?
